tcg.title: Raikou ex SAR 108/076 M6 Storm Emeralda Japanese Pokemon Card
tcg.about: Raikou ex SAR 108/076 from the Japanese expansion pack M6 Storm Emeralda, a Special Art Rare full-art holo card with lightning artwork. HP 200, Lightning type, with the attacks that let you attach an Energy from your deck even on the first turn and the 200-damage Power Rush. Illustrated by Oku. It is in near mint condition with no visible whitening, scratches or dents, as shown in the front, back and close-up photos. Offered as a single card.
tcg.why: A Special Art Rare Raikou ex from M6 Storm Emeralda with full-art holo artwork.
tcg.perfect: Pokemon card collectors who want this card.
